# openobserve_alert_template (Resource)

Manages an alert template: the message body OpenObserve renders when an alert fires.

Templates support placeholders such as `{alert_name}`, `{stream_name}`, `{org_name}`, `{alert_start_time}`, `{alert_end_time}`, and `{alert_url}`, plus `{rows}` for the matched records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openobserve_alert_template" "slack" {
  name = "slack"
  type = "http"

  body = jsonencode({
    text = "{alert_name} fired on {stream_name} at {alert_start_time}\n{alert_url}"
  })
}

resource "openobserve_alert_template" "email" {
  name  = "oncall_email"
  type  = "email"
  title = "[{org_name}] {alert_name}"

  body = <<-EOT
    Alert {alert_name} fired on stream {stream_name}.

    Window: {alert_start_time} to {alert_end_time}

    {rows}

    Open in OpenObserve: {alert_url}
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) Message body. For `http` templates this is the JSON payload sent to the webhook; for `email` templates it is the email body.
- `name` (String) Template name, unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Mark this template as the organization's default. OpenObserve marks a template as the default on its own when it is the only one in the organization, so this can come back true even when it was not requested.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the template belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.
- `title` (String) Email subject line. Only meaningful when `type` is `email`.
- `type` (String) Channel this template renders for: `http` (default), `email`, or `sns`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID in the format `{org_id}/{name}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Alert templates are imported as {org_id}/{name}.
terraform import openobserve_alert_template.slack default/slack
```
